title: Funds swapped into a privacy coin, moved and swapped back
summary: The funds are swapped into a privacy coin, moved once off the record and swapped out to a new bitcoin wallet within 24 hours. A screening tool can seldom follow funds in some privacy coins, because they hide the sender, the recipient and the amount.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 95 cases in 100.
